visualization.name: PDF Viewer
visualization.description: Read PDF documents page by page
visualization.help:
# What is the PDF Viewer?
The PDF Viewer draws a `pdf` dataset in your browser with **PDF.js**, the same way in every browser and on phones.
## Key Features
- **Pages**: Scroll through every page; the toolbar shows which page you are on. - **Zoom**: Zoom in and out, or fit the pages to the width of the window. - **Large documents**: Pages are drawn as they scroll into view.
To learn more about PDF.js, visit: [https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/)
